rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Digital identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Digital handle to identify objects or legal persons.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Related publication
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Reference to something that was made available for the general public to see or buy.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Keyword
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Significant word or concept that are representative of something or someone.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Support channel
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Way of communication used to interact with users or customers.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Specification format
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Form in which a particular data structure or object state is specified in.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Version identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Term or code used to identify the version of something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Release date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Fixed date on which a product is due to become or was made available for the general public to see or buy

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Full name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Whole, non-abbreviated name of something or somebody.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Short name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Shortened or fully abbreviated name of something or somebody.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Type
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Distinct class to which a group of entities or concepts with similar characteristics or attributes belong to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Custodian
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The 'custodian' is a legal person who is responsible for the content and quality of the data, metadata, and/or code of a research product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: License
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Grant by a party to another party as an element of an agreement between those parties that permits to do, use, or own something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Repository
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Place, room, or container where something is deposited or stored.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Is alternative version of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Reference to an original form where the essence was preserved, but presented in an alternative form.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Accessibility
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level to which something is accessible to someone or something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Homepage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Main website of something or someone.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Full documentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Non-abridged instructions, comments, and information for using a particular product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: How to cite
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Preferred format for citing a particular object or legal person.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Version innovation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Documentation on what changed in comparison to a previously published form of something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Serialization format
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Form in which a particular data structure or object state is translated to for storage.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Is new version of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Reference to a previous (potentially outdated) particular form of something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Description
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Longer statement or account giving the characteristics of someone or something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Copyright
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Exclusive and assignable legal right of an originator to reproduce, publish, sell, or distribute the matter and form of a creative work for a defined time period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Developer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Legal person that creates or improves products or services (e.g., software, applications, etc.).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Funding
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Money provided by a legal person for a particular purpose.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Other contribution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Giving or supplying of something (such as money or time) as a part or share other than what is covered elsewhere.
